title.zh: Chainalysis: Ethereum Reorg Triggers THORChain Emergency Pause, Delaying Launder
title.en: Chainalysis: Ethereum Reorg Triggers THORChain Emergency Pause, Delaying Launder

current_state.zh: Chainalysis reported that an Ethereum reorganization on the morning of October 31 caused THORChain to mistakenly issue a double refund on a 10 ETH deposit, prompting an emergency pause that cut off cross-chain swaps across most of its bridges for all users and inadvertently stalled laundering of funds stolen from Binance.
